column1: # G5 phase 3: the trust profile's include capability (docs/trust.md).
# THE RUNNER CONVENTION (the var.tsv precedent of fixed runner-side
# configuration): every row in THIS FILE evaluates under a trust
# profile root-confined to the fixtures directory --
# `trust: { include: { root: __FIXTURES__ } }` in ts/test/spec.test.ts,
# `TrustOptions{IncludeRoot: fixturesDir}` in go/spec_test.go. The same
# profile also covers file.tsv, which is what makes the shared suite
# itself HERMETIC: no row may read outside the repository or resolve
# through installed packages.
# The deny target (test/spec/trust-secret.aontu) is a real committed file
# ONE LEVEL ABOVE the confinement root: confinement is realpath-then-
# prefix-check on the RESOLVED file, so the file must exist for the
# escape to be an escape (a missing path is ordinary not-found -- the
# allowed mechanism ran and missed; denial is reserved for the
# capability refusing the read).
# The nested row proves the profile travels: trust-nest.aontu itself
# includes trust-in.aontu relatively, and the child parse runs under the
# same capability (the resolver reads it from the parse meta the plugin
# copies to every nested include).
trust-allow-in-root
trust-allow-nested
trust-deny-escape
trust-deny-escape-msg
